definition: 46 governed municipality markers from the NJ DCA Development Trends Viewer: 34 public-source facts/series and 12 deterministic Watchdog arithmetic markers.
activation_rule: New markers enter planned. Live state requires the source artifact, authenticated production canary, provider coverage and static governance reconciliation.
